rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policy (and disables FORCE/RLS) on northstar_runtime.saga_state, then drops the saga_state table. The table holds only the durable terminal outcome (status + applied/compensated step names) of saga runs used for idempotent re-execution; on a shared environment export the schema first and restore from the pre-migration backup rather than dropping in place; the outbox_event and job tables from 000002 and all other runtime state are untouched.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
postchecks: row-level security is enabled and forced on northstar_runtime.saga_state with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC

compatibility_window: GATE-KERNEL-GA EVAL-KRN-004 closer: durable saga/compensation terminal state (committed|compensated) for idempotent, tenant-scoped long-running workflows
